notes: Body performs a property-map lookup for the exact DiamondDynasty key, compares PICKEDPITCHER's returned u32 with the supplied u32, and returns true only on equality. The indexed caller invokes it with three property keys and the same selector; string references resolve at their full guest addresses.

The body contains BATTER/PITCHER string checks but continues through a larger callback-selection/dispatch routine; no concise whole-function purpose is established by the available callers. Leaving the semantic name blank is appropriate. Full guest strings resolve to BATTER and PITCHER.

The body checks context state, reads a signed requested position, resolves DD_LINEUP_DATA and its position entries, validates the selected entry's position, then writes selected position-related context fields on success. This is a selection/update routine, not merely a predicate that reports whether a position exists. Full-address strings resolve as DD_LINEUP_DATA and position. No indexed caller was available.

Copies the input text, searches the full-address :DELAY= marker and :UNSKIPPABLE tag, extracts their associated values/presence, and returns a value capped at 5. The direct caller invokes it while preparing text state.

The body resolves Scorebar_SlideUps and ModifiableText and iterates nested attribute records via the evaluator, but its overall output/role is not established precisely enough to name. Retaining a blank semantic name is justified. A caller is present in the behavior index but none adds a clear role.

The body builds and serializes action data using the full-address PORTALROOM key and, in the corresponding action branch, the EnterGame key; subsequent formatting/metadata work supports an action-construction role. No indexed direct caller was available.

Body resolves GAME_LIST_DATA then total_pages, compares that bound with the context's 32-bit page index at +0x98, updates the index in either direction, and signals boundary conditions. No indexed caller was available.

The body selects CROWD_DIS_02 or CROWD_POS_03 according to dispatch result, copies the selected key, applies it through the context update helper using x19+0x50dc, then clears a 16-bit state field. The string leads resolve at their full guest addresses.
